verdict.rationale: A GPU is not a data-collecting service, but NVIDIA markets local AI on the card as "fully private" and stresses running models locally, which implies user data stays on-device rather than going to a training pipeline. That is a single marketing-level claim, not an explicit training opt-out or data-use guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit policy or setting that excludes user data from AI training, coverage of NVIDIA app/G-Assist telemetry and data handling, and independent verification that local workloads send no data off-device.
